behaviour: F1 (reaction-edit-handlers-ack-on-storage-failure): the group reaction handler (kind 7), the delete handler (kind 5) and the chat handler's edit-marked kind-9 branch let storage failures propagate (reject), so the dispatcher keeps the rumor journaled and the next subscription replays it. A failed loadMessages in the reaction handler is a failure, never 'target unknown'. Invalid input (no e-tag, unknown reaction target, a rumor the store discards, an unauthorized or malformed delete/edit) completes and is acked as before. Replay converges: for every storage step of the handling, failing it once (reject, or commit-then-reject for writes) and replaying yields the same stored state as a clean run.
F1: setChatVersion in the delete/edit paths is bumped for every outcome, also when applyDeleteEditSignal fails part way (the sweep may have landed other slots' writes).

F2 (reactions-rejected-write-cache-reconcile): when a reaction write rejects, enqueue re-reads the key from storage inside the same queue slot (and Web Lock), caches what is stored, notifies this tab's listeners, posts the cross-tab notice, and rejects with the write's error. Indeterminate (committed then rejected) converges on the committed rows. If the re-read fails too, the cache entry is dropped (next loadReactions reads storage) and a warning is logged. The cache-first badge-revival guard (c64fe0f) is unchanged: cache.set still precedes the write.
P1: Privacy invariant untouched: local storage only, no new publishes.
non_goals: Retrying the post-append resolvePendingSignalsForSlot in chatHandler (still swallowed; self-heals via the per-thread sweep on the next message or signal of the thread).
